__prompts__.package_name: Your Python package name, in snake case (e.g. my_package)
__prompts__.github_username: Your GitHub username, the owner of the new repo
__prompts__.author: Author name for pyproject.toml file
__prompts__.license: SPDX license expression for pyproject.toml (e.g. LicenseRef-Proprietary)
__prompts__.dev_python_version: Python version for local development, in {major}.{minor} (e.g. 3.12)
__prompts__.github_token_field: GitHub token field path in home_secret.toml, see https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project
__prompts__.cloudflare_token_field: Cloudflare API token field path in home_secret.toml, see https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/home_secret_toml-project
__prompts__.aws_region: AWS region of every environment (dev, tst, prd) and of the CodeArtifact domain (e.g. us-east-1)
__prompts__.aws_account_prefix: Prefix of your AWS account names; bucket names derive from it, such as <prefix>-dev-<aws_region>-data and <prefix>-devops-<aws_region>-artifacts
__prompts__.devops_aws_account_id: AWS account id of the devops environment: it owns the Lambda layer, the artifacts bucket and the CodeArtifact domain
__prompts__.aws_codeartifact_profile: AWS CLI profile for reading private packages from AWS CodeArtifact
__prompts__.doc_host_aws_profile: AWS CLI profile for deploying documentation to AWS S3
__prompts__.doc_host_s3_bucket: AWS S3 bucket for storing versioned documentation
__prompts__.aws_codeartifact_domain: AWS CodeArtifact domain name, also the uv index name
__prompts__.aws_github_oidc_role_name: IAM role name that GitHub Actions assumes through OIDC to read AWS CodeArtifact (role/<name> in .github/workflows/main.yml)
__prompts__.dev_aws_account_id: AWS account id of the dev environment
__prompts__.tst_aws_account_id: AWS account id of the tst environment
__prompts__.prd_aws_account_id: AWS account id of the prd environment
